description: This file provides extension methods for the AnyCodable type, enabling easy conversion of its stored value into common data types such as String, Bool, Int, Double, Dictionary, and Array, as well as obtaining a Foundation-compatible representation.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Converts the stored value to a String if possible.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Converts the stored value to a Bool if possible, handling NSNumber with CFBoolean.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Converts the stored value to an Int if possible, with special handling for NSNumber.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Converts the stored value to a Double if possible.

methods.name: dictionaryValue
methods.description: Converts the stored value to a dictionary [String: AnyCodable] if possible.

methods.name: arrayValue
methods.description: Converts the stored value to an array [AnyCodable] if possible.

methods.name: foundationValue
methods.description: Returns the stored value in a Foundation-compatible format.
